title: A Dynamical Systems view of Feedback Synthesis
summary: Control theory and dynamical systems are closely intertwined fields. Pontryagin's maximum principal offers a strong connection by providing a constructive way to synthesize feedback control laws via lifting the control system to a (Hamiltonian) dynamical system. Feedback laws can then be encoded as invariant manifolds of this induced dynamical system - under the condition that these manifolds project diffeomorphically back to the base control system.
